It then calls LOOP_PATH.read_bytes(), BASELINE_PATH.read_bytes() and RECEIPT_PATH.read_bytes() inline as the arguments to _validate_receipt. The FileNotFoundError comes from the test's own replacement while those arguments are evaluated, before _validate_receipt, _reports() or the baseline_bytes fixture (host_loop.committed_bytes) runs. The test passes whatever the code under test does, so criterion 6 ('Missing ... evidence fails closed') is not actually tested.
findings.paved_road: Exercise the real read paths against a genuinely absent file. For example, point LOOP_PATH and RECEIPT_PATH (via monkeypatch on the module globals) at nonexistent paths under tmp_path and assert that _reports() raises FileNotFoundError. For the baseline, call host_loop.committed_bytes on a nonexistent path and assert that it refuses. Do not make the test's own argument expressions raise.
